title: VAD: Vectorized Scene Representation for Efficient Autonomous Driving
grouping: Three equal top-down road panels in one row with no frames beyond the road itself, each with a bold two-line caption underneath naming one constraint.
shapes_depth: Each panel is a dark-grey two-lane road with light-grey shoulders and a white dashed centre line. Cars are top-view sprites: red for other agents, cyan for the ego car, each repeated as fading ghost copies along its future path. Safety margins are yellow I-beam dimension brackets with bold yellow labels ('Longitudinal Safety', 'Lateral Safety', 'Boundary Safety'); lane direction is shown by yellow arrows and a pink arrow with a parallel mark.
proposed_highlight: Ego vs other agents is the only colour contrast (cyan vs red); the constrained quantity in each panel is the yellow annotation, the brightest element on the dark road.
lesson: Illustrate each driving constraint as a top-down road panel where cars are ghosted repeats along their future path (red for others, cyan for ego) and the constrained distance is a yellow I-beam bracket with a yellow label.
notes: Venue ICCV from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); year 2023 = S2 year and arXiv year. The car sprites are embedded images recorded by refs crop and are left out of the palette (photo_share 0.261).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
